title: National price evolution
visual: Separate purchase and rent panels in EUR/m² and EUR/dwelling where supported. Base-100 comparison over a shared window.
inputs: National price/rent series with exact definitions and units.

title: National governments
visual: The national series with dated mandate bands; annual-change bars with transition years identified.
inputs: Verified national mandates and the same national price/rent series.

title: Inflation and real growth
visual: Purchase and rent panels comparing nominal and constant-euro prices, retaining government bands.
inputs: Documented annual CPI series and common base year.

title: Territorial profiles
visual: Price-level panels and base-100 trends by explicitly defined territorial groups.
inputs: Municipal observations and verified geography classification/aggregation weights.

title: Autonomous communities
visual: Separate maps of levels and percentage changes for purchase and rent; annual-change heatmap.
inputs: Comparable community series, harmonised geography codes and licensed boundaries.

title: Regional governments
visual: Small multiples with mandate bands; descriptive mandate table and annualised-growth comparison.
inputs: Verified regional mandates, coalition composition and comparable price observations.

title: Provinces and municipalities
visual: Provincial/municipal price and growth maps plus preselected local time-series cases.
inputs: Local prices, coverage thresholds and boundaries compatible with observation vintages.

title: Political reading of the evidence
visual: Evidence table by geography and mandate: nominal/real changes, annualised rates, coverage and sources.
inputs: Completed previous sections and traceable calculations.
